# Support

For setup help or a reproducible problem, [open an issue](https://github.com/bubblegump30/PurpleDragonGIFStudio/issues/new/choose) after checking the README and existing issues.

Include your app version, operating system, and the exact step that fails. Remove API keys and personal information. For security concerns, follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Support is provided as maintainer availability allows. Donations are optional and do not guarantee support or a feature.

[Website](https://www.purpledragonfoundationltd.xyz/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/bubblegump30) · [Donate via PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/KyleAustin85)
